meta.title: Exercise library
meta.how_to_use: Pick a split from `splits`. For each slot in the day, choose ONE exercise whose movement_pattern is in eligible_patterns, rotating the choice across weeks. Drop priority=optional slots first when short on time. Filter spinal_load=='low' on back-sensitive days — every core slot has at least one low option.

spinal_load_key.high: Skip or substitute during a flare-up

load_schemes.stack_or_total: total_kg is the whole load (machine stack or single implement)
load_schemes.per_hand: per_hand_kg per dumbbell; total_kg is both
load_schemes.bar_plus_per_side: per_side_kg added each side; bar weight was never recorded

meta.progression_rule: Double progression. Start at rep_range.min. Each session add a rep to each set. When every set reaches rep_range.max with clean form, add the smallest load increment and reset to rep_range.min.
meta.weekly_volume_target: 10-20 hard sets per muscle per week, counting indirect work (presses give triceps and front delts sets; rows and pulldowns give biceps and rear delts sets).

slot_frequency.per_session: Fill every time this day is trained.
slot_frequency.per_week: Fill only if no exercise of an eligible pattern appears in the trailing 7 days of log.jsonl. Requires the generator to pass week context into generate().

constraints: One exercise per movement_pattern per session.
At most one spinal_load=='high' exercise per session.
At most two hinge-pattern sessions per trailing 7 days while reintroducing hinges.
Skip an optional slot whose pattern already appears elsewhere in the same week.
No triceps_compound on a day with two or more horizontal_press picks.
A manual swap updates the session but NOT slot_history.

4_day.label: 4 days/week

slots.label: Curl, elbows forward or neutral to body

4_day.notes: Day 4 is the dense one; superset biceps with triceps. The erector slot is core but per_week: it fills only if no hinge has been trained in the trailing 7 days, so it self-skips when leg day's hip-extension slot already took a hinge.

3_day.label: 3 days/week

slots.label: Curl, elbows forward or neutral to body

3_day.notes: Built for full coverage rather than short sessions: every muscle group the 4-day split trains is trained here too. Seated calves sit on day 1 to keep leg day manageable and to give calves two exposures. The erector slot is per_week and self-skips if leg day already took a hinge.
